players.product: low-loss copper-clad laminate (M8-class) for AI server boards

quarterly_data.signal: Elite Material's investor presentation (CLSA online investor meeting) reports Q2 2026 revenue of NT$47,275 million, up 43.0% QoQ and 110.0% YoY; gross profit NT$16,003 million (gross margin 33.9% vs 29.4% in 1Q26 and 30.3% in 2Q25), operating profit NT$12,734 million (operating margin 26.9%), net income NT$9,872 million (net margin 20.9%) and basic EPS NT$27.55. The company attributes the strong growth in its Infrastructure segment to share gains in high-end materials.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue NT$47,275 million (+43.0% QoQ, +110.0% YoY); GM 33.9%; OPM 26.9%; net income NT$9,872 million; EPS NT$27.55

quarterly_data.signal: Elite Material laminate capacity plan (sheets/month): total 4.35M in 2024, 5.85M in 2025, 6.15M in 2026 (Guanyin, Taiwan 0.30M added), 9.30M in 2027 (additions listed: Kunshan 0.60M, Zhongshan 0.60M, Kunshan 0.60M, Zhongshan 0.60M, Guanyin 0.60M, Penang, Malaysia 0.15M) and 11.10M in 2028 (Kunshan 1.20M, Zhongshan 0.60M); the Penang site is shown at 150K sheets/month in Q4 2027. The company calls this dominant CCL capacity in Southeast Asia and says it is the only Asian CCL supplier with US sales and production presence (California site) - company claims.

Elite Material claims it reached global No. 1 in laminates in 2025 with a 16% market share (by revenue, mass-lamination sales excluded), and has been global No. 1 in high-speed halogen-free (green) laminate since 2023 with a 38.6% share, in a high-speed halogen-free laminate market it shows at $2,656M (2024) and $4,523M (2025); it also claims No. 1 in green laminate and in mSAP/HDI laminate, and says AI infrastructures favor HDI technology.
quarterly_data.figure: 16% global laminate share (2025); 38.6% high-speed halogen-free laminate share; market $2,656M (2024) / $4,523M (2025)
